intelligence.essence: Skills needs its own lens: not who you are, what you give. The core question is what can you do for people — your ability, your service, your unique ability, what you give to the world — like an online résumé of what you offer. Per skill: what it does for them, and how someone starts. And NO proof is demanded at join: they are just filling out joining Naya, inputting that data — take them at their word. Especially a child: ask a child to show proof they are good at something and they will not know what you mean.
